name: The Edit: Tagline [Dark]
description: A dark-themed tagline template with bold typography and a clean reveal motion. Works for brand campaign videos and product launches with a dark aesthetic.

name: The Edit: Tagline [White]
description: A white-themed tagline template with bold type and clean motion. Ideal for brand campaign videos and product presentations with a light aesthetic.

name: The Harvest: Banana Spin
description: A typographic animation where a banana spins through bold serif lettering. Great for food and drink promos and playful brand moments.

name: The Harvest: Fruit Bounce
description: A logo animation with fruit bouncing into a serif wordmark. Ideal for brand intros and food and drink identities.

name: The Harvest: Orange Float
description: A vibrant animation where an orange floats between a stacked serif headline. Perfect for beverage ads and fresh, colorful campaigns by food and drink brands.

name: The Harvest: Peach Plunge
description: A typographic poster perfect for food and drink campaigns and editorial-style promos.

name: The Harvest: Pulp
description: An animated juice label that reveals cold-pressed ingredient details line by line. Perfect for beverage promos and product storytelling.

name: The Harvest: Raspberry Check
description: A typographic animation where raspberries drift inside a bold blue checkerboard frame. Perfect for playful promos and graphic food and drink reveals.

name: The Harvest: Raspberry Glide
description: A typographic animation with layered lettering on a dark, slow motion background. Great for product promos and premium food and drink content.

name: The Prompt: Text To Image
description: An animated UI template showing a text-to-image AI interface from prompt to output. Great for generative AI product demos where showing the moment of creation is the most convincing argument.

name: The Route: Cities
description: A route map template that draws an animated path between city destinations. Perfect for travel apps and location-based content where the journey is part of the story.

name: The Route: Departures Board
description: An animated departures board template with flip-style text revealing destination information. Good for travel product showcases and transport app demos where authenticity matters.

name: The Route: Logo Reveal
description: A template where an animated route path draws itself across the frame and arrives at a logo. Good for travel brand intros and any identity where telling a small story before the reveal makes sense.

name: The Vault: Card Features
description: An animated card UI template that reveals features in a structured layered layout. Great for fintech product demos and subscription plan presentations.

name: The Vault: Feature List
description: An animated feature list template in the Vault fintech style. Good for banking and payments product content that needs to communicate value clearly and confidently.

name: Tilted Text Snap
description: A snappy animated text template where each line rotates in at a slight tilt and settles into place. Great for editorial promos and any brand delivering a punchy, high-energy message.
